lines: shipped — v1.1.9, which is also npm latest (checked 2026-10-08).
Services + hook pipeline, HTTP and WebSocket transport, channels, the browser
client, and the batteries (mail, cache, scheduler, workers, webhooks, AI,
OpenAPI, manifest, devtools, health, the transactional outbox, the backfill).
File storage is not among them and is Litestone's (FJS-D260); junction's…
Shipped. A .mesa component compiler and the signal runtime its output runs on,
a static/SSR renderer, a Vite plugin at the @frontierjs/mesa/vite subpath, and
a REPL. The version is package.json's. History is git; open defects are
../../ISSUES.md; the package map and its traps are CLAUDE.md.
@frontierjs/caravan v0.1.4 — a SQLite-backed job queue and cron scheduler,
exposed as a Junction plugin that attaches app.jobs.
